data.name: Darryl
data.gender_notes: Darryl is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: An old English name derived from the Old Norse name Thorleif. Thor meaning 'thunder' and leif meaning 'life'. Darryl is an Anglicized version of the name and is believed to mean 'rule of the sea'. The name Darryl carries the meaning “Rule of the sea” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English. Parents who choose Darryl usually hope their child will grow to embody rule of the sea and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Emblem of strength and power in the face of life's challenges.
data.etymology: Darryl belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Rule of the sea.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Darryl total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_english.name: Darryl
in_english.long_meaning: The name Darryl is believed to have multiple origins, including possible connections to the English word 'oak tree' or derived from the Old French term for 'darling'. While it does not have a direct reference in the Bible, it is used in Christian communities. Historically, the name may signify strength, like the oak tree, or affection. It has been used across various Christian cultures, often chosen for its strong, yet endearing connotations.

data.cultural_impact: Darryl is often associated with strength and resilience due to its Norse origin. In popular culture, Darryl is the name of various tough and rugged characters, such as Darryl Philbin from The Office and Darryl Strawberry from Major League Baseball. This tough and resilient image allows Darryl to be a name for individuals who wish to identify themselves as strong and unyielding in the face of adversity.
data.spiritual_significance: Darryl's meaning 'rule of the sea' holds a deeper significance when placed in the spiritual context. The 'sea' represents the tribulations and challenges we face in life. The 'rule' signifies the ability to manage and navigate these challenges with grace and wisdom. The name Darryl, therefore, becomes a reminder for Christians to trust in the power of God to help them rule over the challenges of life and come out victorious. It serves as a reminder of the transformative power of God who can take even the stormiest of seas and turn it into calm waters.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Darryl, of Old Irish origin, means "Free as a Deer." In Christian symbolism, it represents the spiritual freedom and grace bestowed upon us through our faith in God. May we always cherish and embody this divine gift.

biblical_reference.note: The name Darryl does not appear in the Bible.

historical_references.reference: The name Darryl first appeared in English records during the 12th century, and it is believed to have originated from the Old French name Darcel or Desiree, meaning 'dear one' or 'desired one'. During this period, the Normans brought the name to England after the Conquest in 1066.

Another possible origin of the name Darryl is from the Hebrew name Dariyal, which means 'rich in the sun'. This name was used in the Middle Ages and may have been adopted by Christians during this period, particularly those with Jewish or Hebrew heritage.
